description: Windrose is the python-windrose contributors' library for summarising wind direction and speed, drawing polar frequency plots and fitting Weibull probability distributions. It accepts NumPy arrays or pandas data frames and uses Matplotlib for graphical output. Optional SciPy routines support distribution fitting, with command-line and notebook examples available. Spatial coverage is the station or area represented by the supplied observations; sampling interval and period are inherited from those inputs. Source is free under dual CECILL-B and BSD-3-Clause licences. A limitation is that observed directional distributions and fitted probability functions do not by themselves predict future weather or resolve airflow around structures. The library can inspect wind-resource or pollution assumptions used in energy and infrastructure exposure simulations. RESKit (platform-reskit) provides related renewable-generation modelling. The README links its JOSS publication. No meteorological records were downloaded.
name: Windrose wind-distribution analysis
